supersedes: Carrier crossover preserved at Git checkpoint 0ced78d; first direct-guide iteration preserved at cb9dd3e.
layout: No fixed-carrier twine eyes or support arm. One continuous line runs from rocker through one integrated actuator fairlead, selected eye of first dual-eye shaft guide, two original centered-eye shaft guides, then trigger series band.

dual_string_guide.selection: Use +Y eye for near phone orientation, -Y eye for far. Guide itself stays in the same orientation.

string_guide.geometry: Original centered-eye guide restored from 0ced78d; existing matching prints reusable.

routing_reason: Broad-face first eye avoids crossing shaft and blue brace. Station -190 retained for direct-route clamp-screw clearance. Integrated actuator eye remains at canonical Z -55 below upper collar fasteners; transition to original X-negative eyes clears the stock neck corner.

checks.targets: Every assembled rigid part, phone and all stock proxies.
checks.dual_guide_body_and_band: Parent verified one valid solid and zero 1.4 mm band/body overlap.

limits: Clearance envelopes are not a force, friction, abrasion or tension solution.
Band retention and actual threading remain physical checks.
No loaded harness validation or camera framing validation is implied.

dual_guide_ears.connection: Flat faces point inward and join the opposite broad faces of the saddle.
